run_train_pose_model: run the pose model training script with a config file path and optional work directory
run_train_with_amp: run the pose model training script with automatic mixed precision enabled via the amp flag
run_train_resume_checkpoint: run the pose model training script resuming from a specified checkpoint or auto resume
run_train_with_visualization: run the pose model training script with visualization output saved to a directory
run_train_override_config: run the pose model training script with custom config options overriding the config file
